findings.observation: saved means, recursive frozen interventions and actual-incoming one-step interventions reconcile under all selected covariance histories
findings.contrary_evidence: selected scales depend on noisy responses; actual-minus-frozen remainders need not average to zero
findings.scope: conditional computational contrasts, with signed carry/current and all-year distributions
limitations: these are not conditional expectations given scales or a percentage-of-blame decomposition

findings.observation: the exact gaussian determinant/signal/noise expectation and paired saved coarse-curve differences are compared at the existing 34 fixed states
findings.contrary_evidence: a global criterion can rationally sacrifice sparse primary contrasts; monte carlo differences are not an equivalence test
